answer_text: Bb × Bb
passage_en: At an autosomal genomic location, an offspring inherits an allele from each parent. Different inherited versions form a heterozygous pair; identical versions form a homozygous pair.
passage_vi: Tại một vị trí bộ gen nhiễm sắc thể thường, con cái thừa hưởng một alen từ mỗi bố mẹ. Các phiên bản di truyền khác nhau tạo thành một cặp dị hợp tử; các phiên bản giống nhau tạo thành một cặp đồng hợp tử.
passage_zh: 在常染色体基因组位置，后代从每个亲本继承一个等位基因。不同的遗传版本形成杂合对；相同的版本形成纯合对。
question: A scientist carries out a cross between two guinea pigs, both of which have black coats. Black hair coat is dominant over white hair coat. Three quarters of the offspring have black coats, and one quarter have white coats. The genotypes of the parents were most likely
review_note: B: Under the stated complete-dominance model, Bb x Bb yields BB:Bb:bb=1:2:1, hence 3 black:1 white. Other offered crosses cannot yield both black parents and white offspring. en/zh/vi alleles, cross signs and ratios agree. Independent Mendelian derivation with NHGRI allele definition as background; not a sourced guinea-pig experiment.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: humans and chimpanzees share a relatively recent common ancestor.
passage_en: Humans and chimpanzees evolved from a shared ape ancestor; humans did not evolve from chimpanzees alive today.
passage_vi: Con người và tinh tinh tiến hóa từ một tổ tiên chung là loài vượn; con người không tiến hóa từ loài tinh tinh đang sống ngày nay.
passage_zh: 人类和黑猩猩是从共同的猿类祖先演化而来的；人类并非由现今存活的黑猩猩演化而来。
question: DNA sequences in many human genes are very similar to the sequences of corresponding genes in chimpanzees. The most likely explanation for this result is that
review_note: A: Broad correspondence across many genes supports recent shared ancestry, not descent from a living sister species. Smithsonian FAQ explicitly identifies shared ape ancestry. All three questions distinguish ancestor from living chimpanzees; all three evidence passages preserve that distinction.
source_locator: How are humans and monkeys related?
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: They carry blood away from the heart.
passage_en: Arteries carry blood away from the heart, while veins bring blood back toward the heart.
passage_vi: Động mạch mang máu đi ra khỏi tim, trong khi tĩnh mạch đưa máu trở lại về phía tim.
passage_zh: 动脉将血液从心脏输送出去，而静脉将血液送回心脏。
question: Which of the following is the correct characteristic of arteries?
review_note: D: NHLBI states arteries take blood away from heart and veins bring it back. Pulmonary arteries defeat the oxygenated-always distractor. en/zh/vi preserve always and away; evidence directions match.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: It must be present in a population before natural selection can act upon the population.
passage_en: Natural selection changes populations when existing heritable differences affect survival and the passing of traits to descendants.
passage_vi: Chọn lọc tự nhiên làm thay đổi các quần thể khi những khác biệt di truyền hiện có ảnh hưởng đến khả năng sống sót và việc truyền lại các đặc tính cho thế hệ sau.
passage_zh: 当现有的可遗传差异影响生存及性状向后代传递时，自然选择会改变种群。
question: Which is a true statement concerning genetic variation?
review_note: C: The question concerns selection on heritable variation already present when it acts, not environmentally directed creation of variants. Smithsonian evolution paragraph describes a new trait improving survival and descent. en/zh/vi preserve temporal before/then relationship; evidence maintains existing heritable differences.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: The fires remove dead and decaying plant matter, reducing the risk of more intense and destructive fires.
passage_en: Periodic fire in fire-adapted ecosystems can consume accumulated dead vegetation and other fuel. Without such fires, fuel can build up and contribute to more severe later fires.
passage_vi: Cháy định kỳ trong các hệ sinh thái thích nghi với lửa có thể tiêu thụ thảm thực vật chết tích tụ và các nhiên liệu khác. Nếu không có những đám cháy như vậy, nhiên liệu có thể tích tụ và góp phần gây ra các đám cháy nghiêm trọng hơn sau này.
passage_zh: 在适应火灾的生态系统中，周期性的火灾可以消耗积累的枯死植被和其他燃料。如果没有这样的火灾，燃料可能会堆积，从而导致后期发生更严重的火灾。
question: Which of the following is the most likely benefit of periodic natural wildfires in some forest ecosystems?
review_note: A: NPS describes dead trees, needles, litter and shrubs accumulating after fire exclusion and subsequent fuel reduction. Restrict to fire-adapted forests and periodic low/moderate fire; not all fires or forests. zh drops explicit some but asks most-likely benefit and does not assert all forests; meaning remains adequate under the same stated ecological scope. Evidence all languages retains fire-adapted qualifier.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: Shuffling of alleles is responsible for the greatest variation in humans.
passage_en: During meiosis, homologous chromosomes can exchange DNA. This crossing over produces new combinations of alleles in eggs or sperm.
passage_vi: Trong quá trình giảm phân, các nhiễm sắc thể tương đồng có thể trao đổi DNA. Hiện tượng trao đổi chéo này tạo ra các tổ hợp alen mới trong trứng hoặc tinh trùng.
passage_zh: 在减数分裂过程中，同源染色体可以交换 DNA。这种交叉互换会在卵子或精子中产生新的等位基因组合。
question: Except for identical twins, no two people are genetically identical. Which of the following statements most accurately describes the main source of variation in humans?
review_note: C: Recombination, independent assortment and fertilization reshuffle existing alleles between individuals. Mutation ultimately creates alleles, but the question asks variation among people. Conventional textbook treatment of identical twins is understood as shared starting genotype, not denial of somatic divergence; do not reject merely on that ordinary idealization. All three versions preserve recombination option. NHGRI crossing-over supports the mechanism; supplementary Kimball Meiosis gives all three sources of reshuffling.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: The frequency of the allele will remain at 0.3 because the population is at Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.
passage_en: If a population remains in Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium with no evolutionary change, allele frequencies remain constant across generations. The elapsed time does not itself change an allele frequency.
passage_vi: Nếu một quần thể duy trì trạng thái cân bằng Hardy-Weinberg mà không có sự thay đổi tiến hóa, thì tần số alen sẽ không đổi qua các thế hệ. Thời gian trôi qua tự nó không làm thay đổi tần số alen.
passage_zh: 如果一个种群保持哈迪 - 温伯格平衡且没有发生进化改变，等位基因频率在各代之间将保持恒定。时间的流逝本身并不会改变等位基因频率。
question: The frequency of a particular allele in a population of 1,000 birds in Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium is 0.3. If the population remains in equilibrium, what would be the expected frequency of that allele after 500 years?
review_note: C: Remaining in Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium is given, so p(t)=p(0)=0.3 after 500 years. Population size and elapsed time cannot negate stipulated equilibrium. en/zh/vi preserve 0.3, 1000, 500 and the if condition. Kimball law states frequencies constant; own substitution is a formal derivation.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: Robert MacArthur and E. O. Wilson
passage_en: Robert MacArthur and Edward O. Wilson developed an equilibrium model of island biogeography and presented it in a 1963 article and a fuller 1967 book.
passage_vi: Robert MacArthur và Edward O. Wilson đã phát triển một mô hình cân bằng về địa lý sinh học đảo và trình bày nó trong một bài báo năm 1963 và một cuốn sách đầy đủ hơn vào năm 1967.
passage_zh: 罗伯特·麦克阿瑟和爱德华·O·威尔逊提出了岛屿生物地理学的平衡模型，并在 1963 年的一篇文章和 1967 年出版的一部更详尽的著作中进行了阐述。
question: Which of the following pairs of scientists pioneered the ecological discipline known as island biogeography?
review_note: A: Wilson's author retrospective credits his collaboration with MacArthur and 1963 article/1967 monograph. Pioneered is read as modern equilibrium island biogeography, not first ever geographical study of island species. Names and role preserved in en/zh/vi and evidence.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: Endosymbiotic model
passage_en: The endosymbiotic explanation proposes that mitochondria and chloroplasts arose from bacteria that became persistent residents inside other cells.
passage_vi: Giả thuyết nội cộng sinh đề xuất rằng ti thể và lục lạp có nguồn gốc từ các vi khuẩn đã trở thành cư dân tồn tại lâu dài bên trong các tế bào khác.
passage_zh: 内共生学说提出，线粒体和叶绿体起源于成为其他细胞内持久居民的细菌。
question: Which of the following theories is based on the notion that mitochondria and chloroplasts evolved from prokaryotic cells?
review_note: B: Cooper describes mitochondria/chloroplasts evolving from bacteria living in larger cells. Separate aerobic and photosynthetic acquisitions, not a single event. All versions preserve organelles and endosymbiosis. Full text obtained through /sites/books/NBK9841/; canonical /books/ URL still identifies same book chapter.
source_locator: The Origin and Evolution of Cells, endosymbiosis
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: Calvin cycle
passage_en: The Calvin cycle uses ATP and NADPH to reduce fixed carbon into carbohydrates. During this use, ATP becomes ADP and NADPH is oxidized back to NADP+.
passage_vi: Chu trình Calvin sử dụng ATP và NADPH để khử carbon cố định thành carbohydrate. Trong quá trình này, ATP trở thành ADP và NADPH bị oxy hóa trở lại thành NADP+.
passage_zh: 卡尔文循环利用 ATP 和 NADPH 将固定的碳还原为碳水化合物。在此过程中，ATP 转化为 ADP，NADPH 被氧化回 NADP+。
question: This process has as its products NADP+, ADP, and sugar.
review_note: D: Kimball carbon fixation uses ATP and NADPH to reduce PGA to PGAL; carrier products are ADP and NADP+. Sugar is carbohydrate/triose-phosphate shorthand, not immediate free glucose in one turn. All languages preserve reactant/product carrier signs; evidence translates reduction and oxidation correctly.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: Phagocytes
passage_en: Invertebrate animals use innate immune defenses including phagocytic cells that engulf foreign material. Vertebrate-style B cells and helper or cytotoxic T lymphocytes are part of adaptive immunity.
passage_vi: Động vật không xương sống sử dụng các cơ chế miễn dịch bẩm sinh, bao gồm các tế bào thực bào để nuốt chửng vật chất ngoại lai. Tế bào B kiểu động vật có xương sống và các tế bào lympho T hỗ trợ hoặc gây độc là một phần của miễn dịch thích ứng.
passage_zh: 无脊椎动物利用先天免疫防御，包括吞噬外来物质的吞噬细胞。脊椎动物式的 B 细胞以及辅助性或细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞则属于适应性免疫的一部分。
question: Invertebrate immune systems possess which of the following?
review_note: B: Alberts Innate Immunity explicitly says invertebrate and vertebrate invaders are engulfed by phagocytic cells; adaptive B/T terminology confined to vertebrates. All versions preserve four cell classes and evidence innate/adaptive distinction. Full source read via /sites/books/NBK26846/.
source_locator: Innate Immunity, phagocytic cells in all animals
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: Lamarck.
passage_en: Lamarck’s historical account associated inherited change with the experiences and acquired changes of parents. Expecting acquired cold tolerance to pass to descendants resembles that account.
passage_vi: Quan điểm lịch sử của Lamarck gắn liền sự thay đổi di truyền với những trải nghiệm và các biến đổi đạt được của cha mẹ. Việc kỳ vọng khả năng chịu lạnh đạt được sẽ truyền lại cho con cháu phản ánh quan điểm đó.
passage_zh: 拉马克的历史观点将获得性遗传与亲代的经历和后天获得的改变联系起来。期望后天获得的耐寒性传递给后代，类似于这一观点。
question: In the mid-1900s, the Soviet geneticist Lysenko believed that his winter wheat plants, exposed to ever-colder temperatures, would eventually give rise to ever more cold-tolerant winter wheat. Lysenko's attempts in this regard were most in agreement with the ideas of
review_note: C: Author textbook attributes experiences and acquired parental change to Lamarck. This is a historical analogy from the stipulated Lysenko belief, not validation of vernalization inheritance. All three questions/evidence preserve acquired-parental-to-offspring mechanism and names.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: NAD+ + H+ + 2e- → NADH
passage_en: Glycolysis reduces NAD+ to NADH while oxidizing glucose-derived material. Fermentation oxidizes NADH back to NAD+, replenishing the electron carrier for continued glycolysis.
passage_vi: Đường phân khử NAD+ thành NADH trong khi oxy hóa các chất có nguồn gốc từ glucose. Quá trình lên men oxy hóa NADH trở lại thành NAD+, bổ sung chất mang electron để đường phân tiếp tục.
passage_zh: 糖酵解将 NAD+ 还原为 NADH，同时氧化葡萄糖衍生物。发酵将 NADH 重新氧化为 NAD+，补充电子载体以维持糖酵解的继续进行。
question: Which of the following reactions occurs in the forward direction during glycolysis but in the reverse direction during fermentation?
review_note: C: Kimball equations show NAD+ reduced during glycolysis and NADH oxidized in lactate/ethanol fermentation. This reverses the carrier half-reaction, not whole glycolysis. en/zh/vi preserve arrows, charges and reverse qualifier. All evidence versions preserve redox direction.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: The proton gradient across the membrane where the ATP synthase is embedded represents potential energy.
passage_en: ATP synthase uses the electrochemical gradient of protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane. Protons flowing through the enzyme toward the matrix supply the immediate energy for ATP synthesis.
passage_vi: ATP synthase sử dụng gradient điện hóa của proton qua màng trong ty thể. Dòng proton chảy qua enzyme về phía ma trận cung cấp năng lượng tức thời cho quá trình tổng hợp ATP.
passage_zh: ATP 合酶利用线粒体内膜两侧的质子电化学梯度。质子流经该酶进入基质的过程为 ATP 的合成提供了直接能量。
question: During oxidative phosphorylation, the energy needed to drive ATP synthesis comes from one source. Which of the following statements states the immediate source of that energy?
review_note: D: Kimball ATP synthase turns proton-gradient energy into ATP; electron transport creates gradient upstream. Distinguish immediate source from ultimate oxidation energy. All three questions preserve immediate and gradient. Vietnamese ma tran for mitochondrial matrix is awkward but context still identifies mitochondrial interior; no competing anatomical structure introduced. Evidence gradient direction preserved.
source_locator: ATP synthase figure and membrane components
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: increased peristalsis in the gastrointestinal tract
passage_en: Sympathetic activation generally inhibits gastrointestinal peristalsis while supporting fight-or-flight responses such as pupil dilation and sweating. Parasympathetic activity generally promotes digestive motility.
passage_vi: Kích hoạt giao cảm nhìn chung sẽ ức chế nhu động đường tiêu hóa đồng thời hỗ trợ các phản ứng chiến đấu hay bỏ chạy như giãn đồng tử và đổ mồ hôi. Hoạt động phó giao cảm nhìn chung thúc đẩy khả năng vận động của hệ tiêu hóa.
passage_zh: 交感神经激活通常会抑制胃肠蠕动，同时支持瞳孔放大和出汗等“战斗或逃跑”反应。副交感神经活动通常促进消化道的运动性。
question: All of the following are stimulated by the sympathetic nervous system EXCEPT
review_note: D: StatPearls ANS introduction directly says sympathetic inhibits GI peristalsis, parasympathetic restores it. Constriction is typical alpha-adrenergic vascular response, not every vascular bed. en/zh/vi preserve exception and motility; evidence generally qualifiers preserved. Full chapter read via /sites/books/NBK539845/.
source_locator: Anatomy, Autonomic Nervous System, sympathetic effects
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: genetic drift.
passage_en: Genetic drift changes allele frequencies through random chance. Its effects can be especially pronounced in small populations.
passage_vi: Biến động di truyền làm thay đổi tần số alen thông qua cơ hội ngẫu nhiên. Các tác động của nó có thể đặc biệt rõ rệt trong các quần thể nhỏ.
passage_zh: 遗传漂变通过随机机会改变等位基因频率。其效应在小种群中可能尤为显著。
question: In a certain pond, there are long-finned fish and short-finned fish. A horrific summer thunderstorm leads to the death of a disproportionate number of long-finned fish to the point where the relative frequency of the two forms has drastically shifted. This is an example of
review_note: C under ordinary catastrophe/chance interpretation: storm mortality is not stipulated to depend functionally on fin phenotype. Disproportionate sampling shifts frequencies. If fin-dependent survival were added, selection would be possible; that premise is not supplied. en/zh/vi all preserve storm and relative-frequency shift (vi weakens disproportionate wording but still preserves shift). NHGRI drift definition read; label application as conditional interpretation.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: All new alleles are the result of nucleotide variability.
passage_en: A mutation changes an organism’s DNA sequence. Mutations in germline cells can be inherited by offspring.
passage_vi: Đột biến làm thay đổi trình tự DNA của sinh vật. Các đột biến trong tế bào mầm có thể được di truyền cho con cái.
passage_zh: 突变会改变生物体的 DNA 序列。生殖细胞中的突变可以遗传给后代。
question: Which statement about variation is true?
review_note: D: Alleles are DNA-sequence variants; new alleles require changed nucleotide sequence under standard genetic definition. Silent mutations disprove all genetic variation produces phenotype; environmental plasticity disproves all phenotype from genotype. NHGRI mutation and allele definitions plus Kimball H-W mutation paragraph read. en/zh/vi universal quantifiers preserved. Evidence itself is background, with explicit derivation here.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: Poorly adapted individuals never produce offspring.
passage_en: Evolution by natural selection involves differences in survival and reproduction associated with inherited traits. A beneficial trait can become more frequent across generations.
passage_vi: Tiến hóa bằng chọn lọc tự nhiên liên quan đến sự khác biệt về khả năng sống sót và sinh sản gắn liền với các đặc điểm di truyền. Một đặc điểm có lợi có thể trở nên phổ biến hơn qua các thế hệ.
passage_zh: 自然选择进化涉及与遗传性状相关的生存和繁殖差异。有益性状可以在几代人中变得更加频繁。
question: Which of the following is not an observation or inference on which natural selection is based?
review_note: B: Selection changes relative reproductive success; poorer adaptation does not imply zero reproduction. Smithsonian evolution paragraph says more individuals with beneficial trait survive, a comparative claim. zh stem reverses grammatical dependence awkwardly but the request to identify the unsupported selection statement and absolute never remains clear. en/zh/vi evidence retains differential reproduction rather than absolute extinction.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: Fermentation
passage_en: Fermentation oxidizes NADH back to NAD+ while reducing an organic intermediate. This replenishes NAD+ for glycolysis when aerobic electron transport cannot do so.
passage_vi: Lên men oxy hóa NADH trở lại thành NAD+ đồng thời khử một chất trung gian hữu cơ. Quá trình này bổ sung NAD+ cho đường phân khi chuỗi truyền điện tử hiếu khí không thể thực hiện điều đó.
passage_zh: 发酵将 NADH 氧化回 NAD+，同时还原一种有机中间产物。当有氧电子传递链无法做到这一点时，该过程可为糖酵解补充 NAD+。
question: When oxygen becomes unavailable, this process regenerates NAD+, allowing respiration to continue.
review_note: C: Fermentation regenerates NAD+ for glycolysis when oxygen-dependent ETC cannot do so. Respiration in stem is broad carbohydrate catabolism shorthand, not ongoing aerobic oxidative phosphorylation. Same loose wording in all languages; evidence narrows correctly to glycolysis. Kimball equations directly read.
source_locator: Fates of Pyruvic Acid, fermentation equations
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: missense mutation.
passage_en: A missense mutation changes a DNA sequence so that a different amino acid is encoded at a particular protein position. Some such mutations alter protein function.
passage_vi: Đột biến sai nghĩa làm thay đổi trình tự DNA sao cho một axit amin khác được mã hóa tại một vị trí cụ thể của protein. Một số đột biến như vậy có thể làm thay đổi chức năng của protein.
passage_zh: 错义突变会改变 DNA 序列，使得在蛋白质的特定位置编码不同的氨基酸。其中一些突变会改变蛋白质功能。
question: Sickle cell anemia is a disease caused by the substitution of an incorrect nucleotide into the DNA sequence for a particular gene. The amino acids are still added to the growing protein chain, but the symptoms of sickle cell anemia result. This is an example of a
review_note: B: Missense changes encoded amino acid while peptide elongation continues; nonsense terminates, frameshift changes reading frame, dimer is UV lesion. NHGRI definition directly supports classification; historical clinical severity is not independently measured here. All three versions preserve substitution vs elongation and the four alternatives; evidence amino-acid change preserved.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: There will be a net flow of water into the bag, causing it to swell in size.
passage_en: Across a membrane that passes water but retains the dissolved solute, water moves toward the side with higher solute concentration. A solute-filled bag placed in pure water therefore tends to take in water and swell.
passage_vi: Qua một màng cho nước đi qua nhưng giữ lại chất tan hòa tan, nước sẽ di chuyển về phía có nồng độ chất tan cao hơn. Do đó, một túi chứa đầy chất tan khi đặt trong nước tinh khiết sẽ có xu hướng hút nước vào và phồng lên.
passage_zh: 在允许水通过但保留溶解溶质的膜两侧，水会向溶质浓度较高的一侧移动。因此，将装有溶质的袋子放入纯水中时，它往往会吸水并膨胀。
question: An eager AP Biology student interested in studying osmosis and the movement of water in solutions took a dialysis bag containing a 0.5 M solution and placed it into a beaker containing a 0.6 M solution. If this bag were instead placed into a beaker of distilled water, what would be the expected result?
review_note: B under standard retained-solute dialysis experiment: exterior distilled water has lower effective solute concentration, so water influx swells bag. Membrane must retain supplied solute; dialysis does not retain every solute. en/vi retain instead; zh lacks explicit instead but clearly asks result in distilled water. zh D says solution rather than solute: both wrong under same retained-solute assumption and distractor still tests outward leakage; flag minor terminology, no new correct alternative. Evidence preserves conditional membrane selectivity.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: They change the habitat in a way that makes it more habitable for other organisms.
passage_en: Pioneer organisms can alter a newly colonized environment, for example by changing substrate or adding organic matter. Under the facilitation model, those changes make establishment easier for later species.
passage_vi: Các sinh vật tiên phong có thể làm thay đổi môi trường mới được colon hóa, ví dụ như bằng cách thay đổi nền đất hoặc bổ sung chất hữu cơ. Theo mô hình tạo điều kiện (facilitation model), những thay đổi đó giúp việc thiết lập trở nên dễ dàng hơn cho các loài xuất hiện sau.
passage_zh: 先锋生物可以改变新殖民的环境，例如通过改变基质或增加有机质。在促进模型下，这些变化使后续物种的建立更加容易。
question: Which of the following is correct about organisms that are the first to colonize a habitat undergoing ecological succession?
review_note: C under classical facilitation model: pioneers can modify bare substrate and allow later colonizers. Not universal across tolerance/inhibition succession; course source explicitly separates all three. Keep standard textbook facilitation assumption rather than exclude awkward breadth. en/zh/vi preserve environmental modification. Evidence explicitly says under facilitation model; Vietnamese colon hoa is awkward loan wording without changed mechanism.
subject: high_school_biology

answer_text: Cyanobacteria have no nuclei.
passage_en: Cyanobacteria are prokaryotes and lack a membrane-enclosed nucleus. Green unicellular algae are eukaryotes with nuclei and other membrane-enclosed organelles.
passage_vi: Vi khuẩn lam là sinh vật nhân sơ và không có nhân được bao bọc bởi màng. Tảo đơn bào màu xanh lục là sinh vật nhân thực có nhân và các bào quan khác được bao bọc bởi màng.
passage_zh: 蓝细菌是原核生物，缺乏膜包被的细胞核。绿色单细胞藻类是真核生物，具有细胞核和其他膜包被的细胞器。
question: How do cyanobacteria differ from green unicellular algae?
review_note: C: WHO cyanobacteria chapter section3.1 calls cyanobacteria prokaryotic lacking nucleus. Green algae are eukaryotes. All versions preserve absence of nuclei rather than walls; evidence preserves nuclear-envelope distinction.
source_locator: section3.1 Cell Types and Cell Characteristics, page164
subject: college_biology

answer_text: parenchyma
passage_en: Parenchyma are living ground-tissue cells used in storage and other basic plant functions. The central pith of a typical dicot stem is primarily parenchyma.
passage_vi: Mô mềm là các tế bào mô cơ bản còn sống, được sử dụng để dự trữ và thực hiện các chức năng cơ bản khác của thực vật. Phần tủy ở trung tâm của thân cây hai lá mầm điển hình chủ yếu là mô mềm.
passage_zh: 薄壁组织是用于储存和其他基本植物功能的活的地组织细胞。典型双子叶植物茎的中央髓部主要由薄壁组织构成。
question: The cell type comprising the pith tissue centered within a dicot stem is the
review_note: A: Typical dicot central pith is storage parenchyma, not sclerenchyma or meristem/whole bundle. Kimball Stems identifies parenchyma pith rays; Michaels cells/tissues additionally describes pith as central ground tissue and parenchyma storage. Typical anatomy assumption retained, not universal for every mature stem. en/zh/vi and evidence preserve center and parenchyma.
source_locator: Kimball Stems pith rays; supplementary OpenStax30.2 Fig30.5 explicitly pith parenchyma

answer_text: It increases diffusion of H+ from the intermembrane space to the matrix.
passage_en: The mitochondrial outer membrane permits small solutes to equilibrate relatively readily. Acidifying the outside can increase intermembrane-space proton concentration, so a gradient toward a less acidic matrix can drive ATP synthase.
passage_vi: Màng ngoài ty thể cho phép các chất tan nhỏ cân bằng tương đối dễ dàng. Việc axit hóa bên ngoài có thể làm tăng nồng độ proton trong khoang gian màng, do đó một gradient hướng về phía chất nền ít axit hơn có thể thúc đẩy ATP synthase.
passage_zh: 线粒体外膜允许小分子溶质相对容易地达到平衡。酸化外部环境可以增加膜间隙中的质子浓度，因此朝向酸性较弱的基质的梯度可以驱动 ATP 合酶。
question: Mitochondria isolated and placed in a buffered solution with a low pH begin to manufacture ATP. Which of the following is the best explanation for the effect of low external pH?
review_note: D: pH decrease increases external proton activity; assuming intact inner membrane, supplied ADP/Pi and relatively more alkaline matrix, inward proton flow drives ATP synthase. Own chemiosmotic application of Kimball source; outer-membrane permeability is ordinary mechanistic assumption. en/zh/vi preserve low pH, intermembrane-to-matrix direction; evidence conditional can and less acidic matrix preserved.
source_locator: proton flow through mitochondrial ATP synthase

answer_text: The blastomere with the gray crescent will form a complete, but small, embryo.
passage_en: In classic amphibian embryo-separation experiments, a blastomere retaining the dorsal gray-crescent region can organize a complete smaller embryo. A separated blastomere lacking that region develops differently.
passage_vi: Trong các thí nghiệm cổ điển về tách phôi lưỡng cư, một phôi bào giữ lại vùng lưỡi liềm xám ở mặt lưng có thể tổ chức thành một phôi hoàn chỉnh nhưng nhỏ hơn. Một phôi bào bị tách ra mà thiếu vùng đó sẽ phát triển theo cách khác.
passage_zh: 在经典的两栖动物胚胎分离实验中，保留背侧灰新月区的卵裂球能够组织形成一个完整的较小胚胎。而缺乏该区域的分离卵裂球则发育不同。
question: In an experiment, the first cleavage plane of an amphibian zygote was manipulated so that the gray crescent was contained in only one of the two blastomeres that result from the first cleavage. The two blastomeres were then separated. What is the expected fate of the blastomeres?
review_note: B: Spemann Nobel lecture opening describes fully isolated amphibian blastomeres yielding smaller whole embryos and dorsal/ventral bisection yielding normal miniature embryo from dorsal half. Gilbert Developmental Biology NBK10101 exact passage says only separated blastomere containing gray crescent develops normally. Both read, distinguishing primary author retrospective from later author textbook; no claim lecture alone explicitly names gray crescent. All three questions/evidence preserve which blastomere and smaller complete outcome.
source_locator: Spemann1935Nobel lecture opening isolated blastomeres and dorsal-half miniature embryo; exact gray-crescent account Gilbert Developmental Biology NBK10101 Fig10.18 and surrounding text (full /sites/books/ representation)

answer_text: The frequencies of some alleles in a population's gene pool has changed over successive generations.
passage_en: In population genetics, evolutionary change is tracked as changes in allele frequencies across generations. A population maintaining the same allele frequencies across generations does not show that kind of evolutionary change.
passage_vi: Trong di truyền học quần thể, sự thay đổi tiến hóa được theo dõi dưới dạng những biến đổi về tần số alen qua các thế hệ. Một quần thể duy trì cùng tần số alen qua các thế hệ sẽ không thể hiện loại thay đổi tiến hóa đó.
passage_zh: 在群体遗传学中，进化变化被追踪为跨代际的等位基因频率变化。若一个种群在各代际间保持相同的等位基因频率，则未表现出此类进化变化。
question: Which of the following must be true in order for evolution to have occurred?
review_note: A: Population-genetic operational definition is change of allele frequencies over successive generations. Not change of an individual's genotype within its life. Kimball law paragraph explicitly contrasts evolution and constant gene pool. All three versions preserve generation vs lifetime distinction; evidence qualifies population-genetic scope.
source_locator: Hardy-Weinberg law and changes in gene pool
subject: college_biology

answer_text: genetic drift
passage_en: The ideal Hardy-Weinberg model assumes random mating and no changes from mutation, migration, selection, or appreciable genetic drift. A very large population reduces random sampling changes in allele frequency.
passage_vi: Mô hình Hardy-Weinberg lý tưởng giả định sự giao phối ngẫu nhiên và không có sự thay đổi do đột biến, di cư, chọn lọc hoặc biến động di truyền đáng kể. Một quần thể rất lớn làm giảm các thay đổi ngẫu nhiên trong tần số alen do lấy mẫu.
passage_zh: 理想的哈迪 - 温伯格模型假设随机交配，且没有突变、迁移、选择或显著的遗传漂变引起的变化。非常大的种群可以减少等位基因频率中的随机抽样变化。
question: Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium generally assumes all of the following EXCEPT
review_note: B: Kimball H-W law fails under mutation, migration, drift, nonrandom mating or selection; ideal large-population model excludes appreciable drift. All versions preserve EXCEPT and random mating. Vietnamese lack of selection is literally thieu su lua chon but context identifies evolutionary selection; not a different biological process. Evidence preserves ideal/no appreciable drift.
source_locator: When the Hardy-Weinberg Law Fails: Genetic Drift
subject: college_biology

answer_text: Juxtamedullary nephrons in the mammalian kidney allow the organism to produce hyperosmotic urine.
passage_en: Juxtamedullary nephrons have loops extending deeply into the renal medulla. Their participation in the medullary countercurrent system helps mammals produce urine more concentrated than body fluids.
passage_vi: Các nephron cận tủy có quai Henle kéo dài sâu vào tủy thận. Sự tham gia của chúng vào hệ thống ngược dòng ở tủy giúp động vật có vú tạo ra nước tiểu đậm đặc hơn dịch cơ thể.
passage_zh: 近髓肾单位的袢深入延伸至肾髓质深处。它们参与髓质逆流系统，有助于哺乳动物产生比体液浓度更高的尿液。
question: Which of the following statements about excretory organs is true?
review_note: D: Full PMC6186196 explains medullary gradient/concentration; full PMC12409785 connects juxtamedullary glomeruli with long loops. Their combination supports can concentrate above tissue fluids; not all urine always hyperosmotic. Fish distractor uses typical teleost physiology. en/zh/vi preserve direction and allow/can; vi uses English juxtamedullary loan without alteration.
source_locator: PMC6186196 introduction and medullary concentrating mechanism; supplementary PMC12409785 long loops connected to juxtamedullary glomeruli
subject: college_biology

answer_text: Plasma membrane
passage_en: A common model of early cell origins begins with self-replicating molecules enclosed by a lipid membrane. Nuclei and mitochondria are later features of eukaryotic cells.
passage_vi: Một mô hình phổ biến về nguồn gốc sơ khai của tế bào bắt đầu với các phân tử tự nhân đôi được bao bọc bởi màng lipid. Nhân và ty thể là những đặc điểm xuất hiện sau này ở tế bào nhân thực.
passage_zh: 早期细胞起源的一个常见模型始于被脂质膜包裹的自我复制分子。细胞核和线粒体是真核细胞后期出现的特征。
question: In the formation of the earliest cells, which of the following components most likely arose first?
review_note: B: Cooper summary explicitly posits RNA enclosed in phospholipid membrane as first cell; nuclei/mitochondria later. This is conventional origins model, not direct observation or certainty about historical ordering. en/zh/vi preserve most likely and the four components; evidence appropriately says common model.
source_locator: Summary: The Origin and Evolution of Cells
subject: college_biology

answer_text: Tyrosine kinase
passage_en: The src gene encodes a protein tyrosine kinase. This enzyme transfers phosphate groups to tyrosine residues in target proteins rather than removing phosphate groups.
passage_vi: Gen src mã hóa một protein tyrosine kinase. Enzyme này chuyển các nhóm phosphate đến các gốc tyrosine trong các protein đích thay vì loại bỏ các nhóm phosphate.
passage_zh: src 基因编码一种蛋白酪氨酸激酶。该酶将磷酸基团转移至靶蛋白的酪氨酸残基上，而非去除磷酸基团。
question: Which of the following is encoded by the src oncogene and catalyzes the specific addition of phosphate groups to cellular proteins?
review_note: D: Reviewed UniProt full text record P12931 names Src tyrosine-protein kinase and describes ATP-dependent phosphorylation of tyrosine. v-src/c-src distinctions do not change offered enzyme class. Canonical browser shell not read as evidence; same underlying record retrieved through rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P12931.txt. en/zh/vi transfer rather than phosphatase and kinase option preserved.
source_locator: UniProt reviewed P12931 full text via https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P12931.txt; RecName and FUNCTION/CATALYTIC ACTIVITY

answer_text: High ratios of primary production to standing-crop biomass
passage_en: The classical ecosystem-development model predicts a high ratio of gross primary production to standing biomass early in succession, with less accumulated organic matter than in later stages.
passage_vi: Mô hình phát triển hệ sinh thái cổ điển dự đoán một tỷ lệ cao giữa tổng sản lượng sơ cấp và sinh khối đứng vào giai đoạn đầu của quá trình diễn thế, với lượng vật chất hữu cơ tích lũy ít hơn so với các giai đoạn sau.
passage_zh: 经典的生态系统发育模型预测，在演替早期，总初级生产量与现存生物量的比率较高，而积累的有机质少于后期阶段。
question: Which of the following characteristics is predicted for an early-successional plant community?
review_note: B: Odum1969 primary p263 visually read: organic biomass accumulates and P/B falls as succession proceeds, making high P/B an early-stage prediction. Course reproduction supports same classical model but do not present as universal law. Vietnamese succession wording and zh standing-crop translated crop are awkward; production-to-standing-biomass ratio target preserved in context. Evidence all versions explicitly labels classical model. Add primary supplementary source and locator.
source_locator: course facilitation/tolerance and succession attributes; primary Odum1969 Science164p263, PDFpage3, visually read P/B decline during succession

answer_text: Random mating
passage_en: In an ideal randomly mating population without forces maintaining associations, recombination reduces linkage disequilibrium across generations. Clonal reproduction and selection favoring particular allele combinations can preserve or create such associations.
passage_vi: Trong một quần thể giao phối ngẫu nhiên lý tưởng không có các lực duy trì sự liên kết, tái tổ hợp làm giảm mất cân bằng liên kết qua các thế hệ. Sinh sản vô tính và chọn lọc ưu ái các tổ hợp alen cụ thể có thể bảo tồn hoặc tạo ra các liên kết như vậy.
passage_zh: 在一个理想的随机交配群体中，若无维持关联的力量，重组会逐代降低连锁不平衡。无性繁殖和针对特定等位基因组合的选择则能保留或产生此类关联。
question: Which of the following factors does NOT promote linkage disequilibrium?
review_note: D under normal sexual random-mating/recombination model with no maintaining forces: D_next=(1-c)D; e.g. c=.2,D=.1 gives .08. Random mating does not instantly eliminate LD; epistasis is interpreted as epistatic fitness selection, not neutral phenotypic interaction alone. PMC6028242 exact recurrence read. en/zh/vi and evidence preserve conditional ideal-model scope; no claim every population has D=0.

answer_text: primary succession
passage_en: Primary succession begins on a newly exposed substrate that lacks an established soil community, such as bare rock or glacial deposits. Secondary succession begins where a previous community has been disturbed but soil remains.
passage_vi: Diễn thế nguyên sinh bắt đầu trên một nền đất mới lộ ra chưa có quần xã đất được thiết lập, chẳng hạn như đá trần hoặc các trầm tích băng hà. Diễn thế thứ sinh bắt đầu ở nơi một quần xã trước đó đã bị xáo trộn nhưng đất vẫn còn.
passage_zh: 原生演替始于新暴露的、缺乏既定土壤群落的基质上，例如裸岩或冰川沉积物。次生演替始于先前群落受到干扰但土壤仍然保留的地方。
question: The process in which pioneer species colonize a bare substrate such as rock, sand, or glacial till is known as
review_note: D: Official Alaska curriculum glossary defines primary succession on new land bare of soil. Standard bare uncolonized substrate assumption, not a bare patch still holding established soil biota. vi ke thua for succession is nonstandard literal wording but all primary/secondary distinctions and bare-substrate context preserved; no changed offered process. Evidence uses canonical dien the.
subject: college_biology

answer_text: dominant sporophyte alternates with an independent gametophyte
passage_en: The familiar fern plant is the dominant diploid sporophyte. It produces haploid spores by meiosis; these grow into smaller, independent gametophytes that produce gametes by mitosis.
passage_vi: Cây dương xỉ quen thuộc là thể bào tử lưỡng bội chiếm ưu thế. Nó tạo ra các bào tử đơn bội thông qua quá trình giảm phân; những bào tử này phát triển thành các thể giao tử nhỏ hơn, độc lập, tạo ra giao tử bằng nguyên phân.
passage_zh: 熟悉的蕨类植物是占优势的二倍体孢子体。它通过减数分裂产生单倍体孢子；这些孢子生长成较小的、独立的配子体，并通过有丝分裂产生配子。
question: Ferns undergo alternation of generations in which a
review_note: A: Kimball fern lifecycle identifies diploid fern sporophyte, meiosis spores, heart-shaped gametophyte, fertilization embryo. Standard mature independent gametophyte and dominant sporophyte; initial embryo may depend on gametophyte. All versions preserve independent vs dependent, mitosis versus meiosis evidence.

answer_text: A DNA sequence that replicates via an RNA intermediate
passage_en: Retrotransposons copy through an RNA intermediate. Their RNA is reverse-transcribed into DNA, which can be inserted into a new genomic position.
passage_vi: Retrotransposon sao chép thông qua một trung gian RNA. RNA của chúng được phiên mã ngược thành DNA, sau đó có thể được chèn vào một vị trí mới trong bộ gen.
passage_zh: 逆转录转座子通过 RNA 中间体进行复制。其 RNA 被逆转录为 DNA，随后该 DNA 可插入到基因组的新位置。
question: Which of the following most accurately describes a retrotransposon?
review_note: C: Helman2011 slide2 explicitly copy/paste through RNA and reverse transcription diagram. en/zh/vi preserve RNA vs protein intermediate and no-replication alternative; evidence accurately adds DNA reinsertion.

answer_text: Fox populations will decrease and hare populations will increase.
passage_en: When a fatal parasite reduces the abundance of a predator, the prey it had suppressed may increase as predation pressure falls, assuming no major replacement predators or overriding changes.
passage_vi: Khi một loài ký sinh gây chết làm giảm số lượng của loài săn mồi, loài con mồi mà nó đã kìm hãm trước đó có thể gia tăng do áp lực săn mồi giảm xuống, với giả định không có sự thay thế đáng kể bởi các loài săn mồi khác hoặc những thay đổi chi phối khác.
passage_zh: 当一种致命寄生虫导致捕食者数量减少时，其原本抑制的猎物可能会因捕食压力下降而增加，前提是没有主要的替代捕食者或压倒性的其他变化。
question: In Sweden, the red fox (Vulpes vulpes) severely limits populations of its prey, including hares. However, red fox populations are sometimes attacked by a fatal parasite, the mange mite. As mite population sizes increase at a given site, how are hare and fox populations most likely to respond at the same site? (Assume that hares have no major predators at this site other than foxes.)

answer_text: Air has a higher O2 concentration.
passage_en: Under ordinary environmental conditions, oxygen gas is much more abundant per unit volume in air than dissolved oxygen is in water. Water is denser, provides greater buoyant support, and resists movement more strongly.
passage_vi: Trong các điều kiện môi trường thông thường, khí oxy trong không khí có nồng độ trên một đơn vị thể tích cao hơn nhiều so với oxy hòa tan trong nước. Nước đặc hơn, cung cấp lực đẩy Archimedes lớn hơn và cản trở chuyển động mạnh mẽ hơn.
passage_zh: 在普通环境条件下，单位体积空气中氧气的含量远高于水中溶解氧的含量。水的密度更大，提供的浮力支撑更强，且对运动的阻力也更大。
question: Which of the following statements is true of air as compared to water?
review_note: B: At ordinary near-surface pressure/temperature, air about20.9%O2 by volume versus dissolved gas in water only small mL/L; not oxygen bound in H2O. BC guideline explicitly gives20.9% and dissolved-solubility context. Water denser/supports motion resistance; thermal inertia question qualitative ordinary environments. All three questions/evidence preserve gas concentration comparison.

answer_text: The interior of the pollen grains had a higher osmotic pressure than did the surrounding environment.
passage_en: Water moves into a cell or grain when the surrounding solution has lower effective solute concentration than its interior. That inward osmotic flow can swell and rupture the structure rather than shrink it.
passage_vi: Nước di chuyển vào tế bào hoặc hạt khi dung dịch xung quanh có nồng độ chất tan hiệu dụng thấp hơn so với bên trong của nó. Dòng thẩm thấu đi vào đó có thể làm sưng và vỡ cấu trúc thay vì làm nó co lại.
passage_zh: 当周围溶液的有效溶质浓度低于细胞或颗粒内部时，水分会进入其中。这种向内的渗透流可能导致结构膨胀甚至破裂，而非收缩。

The starch granules are small enough to enter the lower airways and trigger an asthmatic attack. If this theory is true, which of the following is a correct statement?
